result.summary: The layout is largely intact, but two visual/state inconsistencies stand out: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the current screen, and the favourite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling that hurts visibility.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows 'Profile' as the active tab (green icon and label) while the screen displayed is clearly the Home/discovery feed with delivery address, search and restaurant carousels. The active-state indicator does not match the visible content.
issues.suggestion: Bind the active tab state to the current route so 'Home' is highlighted on the home feed.

issues.description: The favourite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, which blends into the dark image area and reads as low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button treatment (e.g. white circle with dark heart plus a subtle shadow) for all favourite toggles so contrast and affordance stay uniform over any image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a very light grey image background while the neighbouring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven and the white '15–25 min' badge low-contrast against it.
issues.suggestion: Normalise card image treatment (consistent overlay/gradient) and darken the badge background or use dark text so the time badge stays legible on light imagery.
